CommunityApplications.Profile:
**Beltr** turns any song in your own music library into a karaoke track.
A local AI model separates the vocals out, synced lyrics are fetched or transcribed on your server, and the words go up on a TV while everyone's phone becomes a remote — they scan the QR code on screen, and there is no app to install.
Nothing about your library is uploaded. Three containers are published here:
- **Beltr** — the CPU image. Runs anywhere. - **Beltr-NVIDIA** — the same app built against CUDA, for servers with an NVIDIA GPU and the Nvidia-Driver plugin. Dramatically faster. - **Beltr-Intel** — the same app built for Intel integrated graphics and Arc cards, for servers with an Intel processor and the Intel GPU TOP plugin.
Install one of the three, not more — they share the same default paths.
Beltr is a one-time purchase, not a subscription. The container runs free for five songs so you can try it against your own music before buying a key.
Support: https://github.com/CasaVargas/beltr-releases/issues
